status: Pre-result declaration for new dated inverse-futures extension; earlier ETF and perpetual results already observed. Historical research, not a preregistered external experiment.
question: Does contractual basis convergence, coin collateral matching and a cash/cost hurdle improve implementable relative-value returns without forecasting crypto direction?
universe: All BTCUSD and ETHUSD quarterly expiries last Friday Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec, 2021Q1 through 2026Q2. No retrospective winners removed. BTC face100USD, ETH face10USD.
allocation: 40% current NAV capital budget per asset; remaining20% and rejected slots earn cash proxy; no reallocation of rejected slot. One expiry per asset, no overlap.
entry: Final24hour entry schedule per execution_amendment_before_first_simulation; original single-open concept retained in history.
exit: Final24hour unwind ending expiry minus1hour; any remaining contracts invalidate run.
gate: Prior observed F/S-1 must exceed conservative four-leg base roundtrip cost 2*(12+7)bp plus cash return for actual holding days plus2%annual risk buffer. F and S from prior completed hour. No threshold optimisation.
coin_replication: Short n integer dollar-face contracts C; buy net q=C/Fentry underlying as coin margin after paying entry futures coin fee. Wallet mark equity = q+C*(1/Fmark-1/Fentry)=C/Fmark before later fees. No directional rebalancing.
costs: Base spot12bp,futures7bp, each one-way, conservative all-in fee/slippage equivalents charged explicitly. Entry futures coin fee is topped up through spot purchase, so matched wallet remains C/Fentry. Exit coin fee=C/Fexit*7bp; sell resulting entire coin wallet with spot12bp. Stress20/12 and30/20bp; unchanged gate.
execution: At1000000capital, each leg order <=1% prior24h mean hourly notional volume; inverse volume contracts times face. Spot+futures open assumed simultaneous with costs; missing orderbook/asynchronous-leg risk explicit.
valuation: Hourly cash + coin margin equity valued at contemporaneous spot; inverse mark for unrealised PnL. Missing raw mark bars investigated; flagged forward-basis proxies for valuation only, never fills. Unavailable spot open follows existing executable flag.
risk: Hourly mark-high/spot stress; equity_coin/(C/Fmark) margin ratio. Guard10%; any breach invalidates liquidation-safe claim. No leverage scaling to boost numbers.
inference: Quarterly episode/annual regime returns and block uncertainty; standard daily Sharpe not sufficient for convergence carry. Cash benchmark must be included.
selection: Both fixed strategies reported. No choosing best horizon, asset, expiry, threshold or period after seeing results. Performance of existing strategies may motivate this branch but is not independent confirmation.
limits: Single exchange, coin custody and default risk; USDT spot/USD futures parity assumption; no tax or transfers; no orderbook. Default and stablecoin haircuts separate from observed-return statistics.

execution_amendment_before_first_simulat.reason: Observed archive contract volumes make a single400k open needlessly capacity constrained. No strategy PnL has yet been run or inspected. Use a declared24hour schedule rather than assume unlimited single-bar liquidity.
execution_amendment_before_first_simulat.entry: Decision at expiry minus60days08UTC using07UTC completed close. Spread40%NAV budget per asset over24hourly opens09UTC through next08UTC. No favourable intrabar fills; each slice capped at1%previous24h mean hourly notional. Unfilled budget remains cash.
execution_amendment_before_first_simulat.exit: 24hour scheduled unwind from expiry minus24hours through expiry minus1hour. Each hour target ceil(remaining_contracts/hours_remaining), capped by prior-hour known participation limit. Any unclosed contracts at last scheduled hour invalidate the run.
execution_amendment_before_first_simulat.coins: Spot quantities rounded up to conservative0.001coin on entry; integer inverse contracts. Exit spot sales rounded down to0.001; coin dust retained and marked, never written off or credited as cash.
execution_amendment_before_first_simulat.gate: Original gate fixed at initial prior-hour basis and cash/cost hurdle. No reselection during execution window.

capacity_amendment_before_first_complete.reason: First1M simulation aborted in development before any completed PnL table: ETH Dec2022 left9contracts(90USDface) at scheduled unwind under1%participation. Retain failure as capacity finding. Use100k proof-of-concept book; no thresholds, dates or asset choices changed. Later performance has not yet been evaluated.
capacity_amendment_before_first_complete.claim_limit: No claim of1M capacity.100k run must still pass every exit and liquidity check.

cash_proxy_revision.reason: Daily FamaFrenchRF rounded0.01percentagepoint creates coarse252xannual yield steps. Replace cash proxy uniformly with official NYFedSOFR, seven calendar-day information lag and25bp cash management spread (floor0), actual360 converted to365 equivalent. No asset, forecast, thresholds or model reselection. All strategies and stress cases rerun.
cash_proxy_revision.status: Sensitivity/accounting refinement after historical results were seen. Later evaluation remains retrospective, not pristine unseen test.

cash_proxy: NYFedSOFR minus25bp, floor0, available7calendar days after effective date; ACT360 accrual. Off-exchange free cash only, same proxy as benchmark; reserved margin no interest. Assumed cash-investment return, not actual fund total return.
missing_print_signal_guard: Flagged spot valuation proxies cannot create daily entry decisions. Funding forecast training features require a fully observed169-hour price window; proxy-based price features are excluded. Applied uniformly after preliminary results, without parameter or asset selection.
